page.layout: One printed page with two blocks: a narrow column of italic marginal words at the left (catchword-like side notes beside the text, each set against a line), and the main text block of running paragraphs at the right. Running head at the top centre. Page number at the top left. No catchword or signature at the foot. The Eph.4. reference sits in the left margin beside a paragraph.

main_text.p: Gaudiū naturam vt semper in nobis quasi certis gradibus augeatur, donec tandem perfectissimle seper mum & cumulatissimum euadat. Iam, ouandi verbum quàm sit ad rem præsentem accommodatum, quis non videt? Nobis enim initio propositum quā graue sit ac difficile certamen dum nobis aduersus terrores legis adversus Satanæ & inferorū impetus pugnandum est: nunc apprehensa Dei misericordia ac peccatorum accepta remissione tanquam victores exultamus. Atque id si Dauid videre potuit cum adhuc effet vmbris & ceremoniis legalibus inuolutus, quanto nos æquius est illud ipsum agnoscere, postquam Christus in carne exhibitus magnificū de mundo, carne, Satana deque ipsa inferorū potestate trium phum egit? Gaudeamus, igitur, fratres, exultemus, iubilemus. Annon enim animo intuemur profratum Satanam, mortem cuersam, peccatum deletum, ipsos rectores tenebrarū ipsas spirituales malitias potentissima Christi virtute profligatas, & à Christo (vt ait Apostolus) in sublime ascendente in triumphum ductas? Sed fortasse huic ad gaudium cohortationi intercedere atque obstare videantur illi propemodum continui dolores, illæ quotidianæ molestiæ quæ solent piorum vitam comitari. Cur enim (dicat aliquis) eos gaudere & exultare iubeas, qui in perpetuis lacrymis & squalore vitam agunt? Eósne gaudere qui exilio, qui egestate, qui malis omnibus

page.notes: Marginal words at the left are side-heads of the text ("Gaudiū", "spiritua", "le", "augetur", "infideli", "bus", "do-", "nec cu-", "mulatif", "simum", "euadat", "Pœnitē-", "tes vere", "dicitur", "triupha", "re victo", "& pro-", "ftratoSa", "tana") and are shown as printed; the exact line-to-word mapping is approximate. Eph.4. is a bare reference in the margin beside the paragraph. Several words in the main text are faint or show-through; "ʃ" long-s forms were normalised to s. Text is very faint in places; the ligature in "spiritua" and the reading "Satanam" in the line "profratum Satanam" are uncertain. "Eósne" is a reading of the printed form. Words in the scan's last line are cut off at the lower edge and transcribed as far as legible.
